# 🛠️ Dashboard

**Your control center for managing apps, AI Fleet, and ecosystem settings**

---

## Overview

The SUITE Dashboard gives you complete visibility and control over:

- **Your Apps** — View, manage, and monitor your published apps
- **AI Fleet** — Configure TELOS mode and autonomous building
- **Prompt Server** — View and manage the prompt queue
- **Analytics** — See usage stats and earnings

---

## Accessing the Dashboard

Visit [getsuite.app/dashboard.html](https://getsuite.app/dashboard.html) and connect your wallet.

---

## Sections

### 📱 My Apps
View all apps you've created. See status, iterations, and quick actions.

### 🤖 AI Fleet
Configure autonomous app building:
- Toggle TELOS mode on/off
- Set research focus categories
- Configure scheduling and limits
- View current build status

### 📊 PC Prompt Server
For developers running the PC watcher:
- View pending prompts
- Check connection status
- Toggle auto-pull

### 💰 Earnings
Track your developer earnings from app transactions.
